# Design System Master File — LamsaTap (لمسة تاب)

> **LOGIC:** When building a specific page, first check `design-system/lamsatap/pages/[page-name].md`.
> If that file exists, its rules **override** this Master file. If not, follow the rules below.

**Project:** LamsaTap
**Generated by:** ui-ux-pro-max `--design-system --persist` (2026-09-27, dials: variance 6, motion 9, density 3), then **rewritten to the approved company decisions**. The skill's rule is that approved decisions override its generic output.
**Sources of truth:**
- `work/2026-09-27-brand-identity/brief-gm040.md`
- `web-art-director.md` «الاتجاه 3»
- `brand/tokens.css`
- `management/decision-register.md` (GM-020, GM-021, GM-038 to GM-044)

**Stack:** static HTML/CSS/JS, no build step and no Tailwind. Runs from file:// and from a local server. No external requests at runtime (GM-006).

### What the tool suggested vs what we use (and why)
| Tool output | Used instead | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Blue accent #2563EB, zinc palette | Ink #14201F + sand/white. Accent per audience: #9A5B00 restaurants, #0B7A75 hosts | GM-020, GM-039, GM-040 |
| Playfair Display SC + Karla via Google Fonts | Readex Pro (Arabic) + Figtree as "LT Latin", both self-hosted | Approved fonts; GM-006 allows no external requests |
| Glassmorphism, shadows sm–xl | Flat surfaces, depth from 1px borders and photos, no shadows | GM-038 («العمق بالحدود والصور») |
| Flip plugin page transition | GSAP core + ScrollTrigger only (vendored) | Flip isn't vendored; downloads need owner approval |
| "Minimal single column" pattern | Gateway with two doors + two audience pages | GM-040 / GM-043 |
| Anti-patterns "cheap visuals, fast animations" | **Kept** | Matches the owner ("high quality animation") |

---

## Global Rules

### Color (light only on company pages: `<html data-lt-scheme="light">`)
| Role | Value | Token | Contrast |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ink (text, logo, primary action) | `#14201F` | `--lt-ink`, `--lt-text`, `--lt-action` | 15.64 on sand, 16.72 on white |
| Background | `#FAF7F2` | `--lt-bg` / `--lt-sand-50` | — |
| Surface | `#FFFFFF` | `--lt-surface` | — |
| Surface 2 | `#F3EEE6` | `--lt-surface-2` / `--lt-sand-100` | — |
| Border (1px only) | `#E4DCD0` | `--lt-border` | decorative |
| Muted text | slate | `--lt-muted` | 5.94 on sand |
| Links & focus ring (company pages) | ink | `--lt-link`, `--lt-focus` | focus ring 3px + 3px offset |
| Accent, restaurants | `#9A5B00` | `--lt-accent` under `[data-audience="restaurants"]` | 5.08 on sand |
| Accent, hosts | `#0B7A75` | `--lt-accent` under `[data-audience="hosts"]` | 4.85 on sand |
| Scan-tail glow | saffron `#F2A93B` / sea `#3FC1B6` | `--lt-accent-glow` | decorative only |

**Where the accent may appear:** icons, lines, indicators, check marks, the 2px core of the scan line, and the underline of the current nav link.
**Where it may never appear:** coloured text, coloured backgrounds, coloured buttons. Saffron is never text on light.

### Logo (GM-041 / GM-042)
- **Files:** `website/assets/brand/logo-horizontal.svg`, `logo-stack.svg` and `logo-stack-since.svg` (ink #14201F), plus the favicon set.
- **Never** recolour, redraw or edit them.
- **Header:** 32px mobile, 40px desktop. Header is 64/80, sticky. Clear space around the logo: 16 mobile, 20 desktop.
- **Footer:** stacked version. The "since" version only at ≥160px width. Clear space: 40 around the 120w stack, 48 around the 160w since-stack.
- **Visual language derived from the logo:** see art direction §11. The QR modules in the intro share the rounded-square language of the symbol's four pieces.

### Typography
- **Families:** Arabic Readex Pro; Latin and numerals Figtree ("LT Latin", weight-matched, tabular numerals).
- **Scale:**
  - h1: 72 desktop, 52 tablet, 40 mobile.
  - Body: 16px minimum, line-height ≥1.5.
- **Weight contrast echoes the wordmark** (700 vs 400), **only** for "a number and its meaning": price figure and unit, the 5-unit figure, step numbers.
- **Headlines:** one weight, 500.
- **Icons:** 1.75 rounded stroke, no fill.
- **The four-point star never appears outside the logo:** alone it reads as an "AI sparkle".
- **Avoid:**
  - All-caps eyebrow labels.
  - Single-word colour accents in headlines.
  - "·"-joined meta strings. The only exception is the approved risk line.

### Spacing & layout (density 3 = spacious)
- **Spacing scale:** `--lt-space-4 … 128`.
- **Container:** 1200px.
- **Gutter:** 20 (<768), 32 (≥768), 48 (≥1024).
- **Section spacing:** 72 mobile, 96 tablet, 128 desktop.
- **Radius, from the logo (§11 «لغة الشعار في الموقع», art direction line ~2568):**
  - Cards and in-layout photos: 8.
  - Buttons: 14.
  - 22 is for client pages only.
  - **No pill (999) on company pages**, because the logo has no pill.
  - The doors are two pieces of the symbol: one big outer corner at 25% of the door's width (max 120px desktop, 88px mobile), other corners 8. On desktop the big corners are top-right and top-left; on mobile they are mirrored.
  - QR modules: rounded squares with a corner of 6% of the module side.

### Motion (dial 9 = complex, but every moment has meaning)
- **Engine:** GSAP 3.15 core + ScrollTrigger from `website/vendor/gsap/`, on company pages only. Client pages never load GSAP (GM-011).
- **Performance:**
  - Transform, opacity and clip-path only.
  - Canvas for many modules.
  - No layout reads inside loops.
  - Pause work that's off-screen.
- **Accessibility and robustness:**
  - `prefers-reduced-motion` shows the final state.
  - No JS shows all content.
  - **Fail-open:** any init error removes every hiding class.
- **Tokens:** one global easing/duration scale.
  - Micro-interactions: 150–300ms.
  - Scan sweep: 700–900ms.
  - Exits run at 60–70% of the enter duration.
  - Only one scan line is on screen at a time, and it never sweeps across body text.

---

## Component Specs (company pages)
- **Primary button:**
  - Ink, radius 14 (not a pill, §11), white label, 44px minimum height.
  - Press feedback is scale 0.97–1.
  - The label says exactly what happens, e.g. «… على واتساب».
  - The approved risk line sits under every plan button: «أسبوعين ببلاش · ما عجبك؟ نشيل العتاد، بدون دفع مقدم ولا التزام في التجربة».
- **Header WhatsApp:**
  - Outlined, radius 14, not filled, so each screen keeps one primary action.
  - Hidden while `config.js` has no number.
- **Telegram secondary link (GM-047):**
  - A plain text link «أو كلمنا على تليجرام» next to or under every primary WhatsApp button.
  - Ink colour, underlined, 44px tap area.
  - It is never a second button, to keep primary-action.
  - The footer carries the Telegram channel link.
  - Usernames without @ come from `config.js` (`telegram`, `telegramChannel`).
  - Both are intentionally empty, and an empty value hides the link.
  - URLs are built as `https://t.me/<username>`.
  - There are no unit-guide `?start=` links until the lawyer answers.
- **Response promise (GM-046):** «خلال ساعة، من 9 الصبح لين 11 الليل، كل يوم» is a trust line near the contact actions.
- **Cards:**
  - White on sand, 1px border, radius 8, no shadow.
  - Hover changes only the border or a small lift of 2px or less, with no layout shift.
- **Photos:** two layers:
  - B&W bottom and colour top.
  - The scan reveals the colour, which then stays.
  - Without JS the page shows B&W. With reduced motion it shows colour.
  - Decorative photos use `alt=""`.
- **FAQ:** `<details>` elements, 8 or fewer per page.
- **Prices:** only from `services/pricing.md` (GM-045, replaces GM-044). Never write «شامل الضريبة».

## Page Pattern
- **Gateway `index.html`:**
  - The intro, where the barcode becomes our logo.
  - The promise, then two doors.
  - «كيف نشتغل», then «اسأل إنسان», then the footer.
  - No prices.
- **Audience pages (`restaurants/`, `hosts/`):**
  - Expanding hero, then problems, then the pinned story.
  - The live demo.
  - That audience's plan only, then its FAQ, then the closing.
  - A prefilled WhatsApp message per page.

---

## Anti-Patterns (Do NOT Use)
- ❌ **Cheap visuals and fast, twitchy animations:** the owner asked for high-quality animation.
- ❌ **Dark sections or dark mode on company pages** (GM-038).
- ❌ **Mentioning clinics, or barber/salon/workshop scenes** (GM-043).
- ❌ **The other audience's prices on an audience page** (GM-040).
- ❌ **External fonts, CDNs or network requests at runtime** (GM-006).
- ❌ **Emoji as icons:** use inline SVG only.
- ❌ **Layout-shifting hovers, instant state changes, or invisible focus.**
- ❌ **Splitting Arabic words into letters for animation:** it breaks shaping.

## Pre-Delivery Checklist
- [ ] **Accessibility:**
  - [ ] Text contrast is 4.5:1 or more, and icons/UI 3:1 or more, on white, sand and sand-2.
  - [ ] Focus is visible (ink, 3px) and keyboard order is logical in RTL.
  - [ ] Touch targets are 44×44 or larger with 8px spacing.
- [ ] **Responsive:**
  - [ ] Layouts are checked at 375/390, 768, 1024 and 1440.
  - [ ] No horizontal scroll.
  - [ ] `scroll-padding-top` equals the header height.
- [ ] **Motion:**
  - [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` gives the final state.
  - [ ] With JS disabled, all content is visible.
  - [ ] Zero console errors.
  - [ ] Fail-open is verified by forcing an error.
- [ ] **Performance:**
  - [ ] Image `width`/`height` are set, CLS is under 0.1, the LCP image is prioritised, and below-fold images are lazy.
  - [ ] There are no external requests (check the network log).
- [ ] **Logo consistency:** §11's 10-point checklist (GM-036), including: no radius 999 on company pages, no star outside the logo, and the QR scans at 3 sizes.
- [ ] **Brand:**
  - [ ] The logo files are unchanged (hash matches `brand/logo/v1.0.0/MANIFEST.txt`).
  - [ ] Accent usage follows the rules above.
- [ ] **Copy and prices:** only from web-copy.md «الاتجاه 3» and services/pricing.md. Nothing links to `shops/`.
- [ ] **Skills:** ui-ux-pro-max pro-rules.md checklist done. The impeccable audit, GSAP review, frontend-design critique and seo-audit are run, with their checklists in `work/2026-09-27-brand-identity/skills/`.
